tut_step_browser_desc: Choose Chrome, Brave or Opera GX. Use the one you normally use. If unsure, leave it on Chrome.
tut_step_pw_desc: Leave blank. A random password will be generated automatically. You can also set your own.
tut_step_accounts_desc: Default is 1. Increase this number if you want to create multiple accounts at once.
tut_step_start_desc: When ready, click Start Account Creation. The tool will open your browser, fill in the ExitLag form and submit it. ⚠️ Creating the account does not activate the trial. You still need to use ExitLoader afterwards.
tut_step_stealth_desc: Hides the browser during account creation. Useful if you don't want to see the automation happening.
tut_step_vanish_desc: Automatically closes the browser a few seconds after the account is created.
tut_step_2fa_desc: If ExitLag requests a 2FA code when logging in via the app, click here and follow the instructions.
tut_step_config_desc: Saves and loads your last settings. Click to open the sidebar and use Save or Load and Start.
tut_step_accounts_wing_desc: All created accounts are automatically saved here. No need to write them down.
tut_step_exitloader_desc: Click Serial → Launch ExitLag to activate the trial. If another account is connected, use Logout first. Or use Switch to change accounts without logging out.
tut_step_autopatch_desc: Enable AutoPatch so you don't need to click Serial or Launch.
tut_step_refcard_desc: Still confused? This card summarizes all scenarios. Keep the panel open and use it as a quick reference.
tut_step_done_desc: All set. If you ever need to review how it works, click the ? button in the sidebar to repeat this tutorial.
confirm_turbo_text:
Turbo fills forms at maximum speed.

This may trigger reCAPTCHA detection and cause the script to fail.

Do you want to continue?
confirm_uac_text:
Your Windows is configured to run programs as Administrator automatically, without warning.

This causes Brave not to open correctly. It freezes or doesn't start when in Admin mode.

Fix UAC corrects the Windows configuration (requires restarting the PC).
confirm_restart_text:
Configuration corrected!

Restart the computer for the change to take effect. After that Brave will work normally.
confirm_batch_text:
Batch mode opens multiple browser instances simultaneously.

With many accounts, this may freeze your computer.

Do you want to continue?
confirm_2fa_text: If ExitLag is asking for a code during Login, use this option to create a temporary email with a special inbox to receive the code automatically. Only use this if ExitLag is asking for a code. DO NOT USE IF EXITLAG IS NOT ASKING FOR A CODE.
confirm_dll_missing_text:
Exitlag.dll was not found in the app folder.

Do you want to restore it before starting?
confirm_exitlag_notfound_text:

confirm_exitlag_pynotfound_text:
ExitLag was not found automatically.

gx_splash_modal_desc: Opera GX displays an animated splash screen every time it starts. With this option active, it is suppressed before it appears — the browser opens directly, without the animation.
tut_loader_step_buttons_desc: Use Login, Logout, Switch and Serial to manage accounts. Hit Launch ExitLag when ready.
tut_loader_step_autopatch_desc: Automatically resets the trial when you open ExitLag via shortcut. Toggle it on or off here.
tut_loader_step_hint_desc: Hover over any button to see a tip here. The guide changes based on your mode.
tut_loader_step_done_desc: The ExitLoader is ready to use. Close this panel any time by clicking the loader button.
